# Dorian Award for Outstanding Broadway Play

}}
The Dorian Award for Outstanding Broadway Play is one of the main categories of Dorian Theatre Awards, given annually to the best production of a new play on Broadway by GALECA: The Society of LGBTQ Entertainment Critics since 2010 (the group was initially named the Gay and Lesbian Entertainment Critics Association). The category was introduced in 2023 when the awards began honoring Broadway theatre.
